context: Spring WebFlux reactive HTTP client adapter for Apache HttpComponents: converts Set-Cookie response headers into ResponseCookie objects.
Spring Boot jOOQ auto-configuration: detects the SQL dialect of the application's DataSource at startup.
Spring core utility that parses MIME type strings (e.g. from HTTP Content-Type/Accept headers, which are client-controlled).
Spring core utility that parses locale strings such as "en_US" or "de_DE_POSIX" into java.util.Locale.
Spring Batch flat-file reader: tokenizer that splits a delimited (CSV-style) line into fields, trimming whitespace and quotes.
Spring Integration transformer that parses incoming syslog messages into a Map; a single instance is shared by all threads processing a message channel.
Spring Security role hierarchy: precomputes, for every role, the set of roles reachable transitively (e.g. ROLE_ADMIN > ROLE_USER). The hierarchy is configured from a string at startup.
Spring Kafka listener container: public accessor called from arbitrary application threads while the consumer thread concurrently updates partition assignments during rebalances.
Spring Data Cassandra: builds a CQL counter UPDATE assignment from an increment/decrement operation whose value is a java.lang.Number (callers may pass a long).

Spring Session Redis repository (inner session class): renames the session keys in Redis when the session id changes, e.g. on login for session-fixation protection. Sessions of anonymous users have no principal name.
